v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the APWorld for Re-Volt (RVGL).

Features included:

- Support for base game content and Dreamcast content
- Four victory goals
- Three logic difficulty levels
- Cars, tracks and cups as items
- All the in-game Progress Table checks as locations, plus Carsanity (win a race with each car)
- Highly modular locations for a customizable game

See the [readme](https://github.com/HansyRod/Archipelago-RVGL/blob/rvgl/worlds/rvgl/docs/en_RVGL.md) for full details.
